thread_text:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — we need a short checklist for the new pricing playbook changes before we flip the feature flags. Sales' asks: Starter default quotas, burst behavior, and explicit contract language for softcaps. Can we map owners and gating criteria?
Diego (Eng): Engineering thoughts: runtime capacity validation (p95 under expected load), per-tenant burst isolation working, autoscaler safety limits. Do we have historical usage to pick a safe Starter baseline?
Lina (RevOps): Sales sent a pilot spec: Starter baseline = 50k tokens/month, burst allowance = 200k tokens/month (softcap) with overage credits. Trial grace of 14 days. Need definition of how bursts are metered vs baseline for billing.
Diego (Eng): We emit per-request token counters already. Two options: enforce burst at gateway (reject/queue) or allow and bill post-hoc. Enforcement preferred to avoid massive surprises.
Samir (SRE): Gateway enforcement ok but requires circuit-breaker to avoid eviction storms on overloaded hosts. Rollout plan: staged deployment 5% tenants (low-QPS) → 25% → 100% with health checks at each stage. Health checks: error rate < 0.5%, queue depth < 3, p95 latency delta < +30ms.
Priya (Legal): Contract note: softcap must be non-binding language "expected monthly usage". For pilots, auto-billing of overage must be opt-in. Any SLA tied to tiers needs a refund/credit formula — will draft template.
Lina (RevOps): For pilots we can set overage to manual approval. For GA we need deterministic billing. Proposal: separate SKU for burst overage (e.g., starter-burst-overage) and track burst usage as a distinct metric.
Ava (PM): Can someone draft a 1-pager: per-owner launch gates (3 bullets each) + a sample billing schema? Need this for Friday handoff to Sales & Legal.
Diego (Eng): I'll own runtime gating + quota YAML sample. Draft YAML snippet: ```
quota:
  tier: starter
  baseline_tokens: 50000
  burst:
    enabled: true
    burst_tokens_per_month: 200000
    enforcement: gateway
    softcap: true
    overage_sku: starter-burst-overage
```
Samir (SRE): I'll own rollout & observability. Telemetry we need: pricing.tier_assigned, pricing.token_usage, pricing.burst_enter, pricing.burst_exit, pricing.overage_invoiced. Add alert: tenant burst_enter rate > 3x baseline within 1 hour.
Lina (RevOps): I'll own billing schema, SKU naming, and migration for pilots → GA. Question: give Sales a self-serve toggle for burst enable?
Ava (PM): Intent is a Sales toggle but gated by RevOps & Legal approvals. Lina include a manual override flow for pilots.
Priya (Legal): Also add trial grace clause and explicit opt-in for pilot overage billing in the pilot agreement. I'll draft the clause.
billing-bot: Invoice preview (preview-only): https://billing.redwood.example/pilot-preview?sku=starter-burst-overage :mag:
Ava (PM): Final ask — propose GA success criteria (go/no-go): 1) billing accuracy < 0.5% mismatch in pilot samples, 2) p95 latency regression for Starter tenants < 25% of tenants affected, 3) sales runbook + pilot opt-in flow complete. Approve?
Diego (Eng): Approve. I'll add perf harness and latency regression tests.
Lina (RevOps): Approve. I'll add a sample invoice and reconciliation checklist.
Samir (SRE): Approve. I'll prepare SLO docs and rollback playbook.
Priya (Legal): Approve. I'll prepare the pilot clause and single-line SLA appendix.
Ava (PM): Thanks all — I'll compile the 1-pager and circulate by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
